card.title: Nintendo Switch restarts when you put it into standby Repair

source.title: Nintendo Switch restarts when you put it into standby Repair

claims.statement: A Switch that restarts on entering standby: check the MOSFETs above the USB-C port and replace faulty ones.

procedure: Test MOSFETs above the USB-C port; replace faulty ones.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
